sn35.93:1.2: Kathañca bhikkhave dvayam paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhoti || || 3
sn35.93:1.3: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ || ||
sn35.93:1.6: Itthetaṃ dvayaṃ calañceva vyayañca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi ||
sn35.93:1.8: Yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya || so pi hetu so pi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī ||
